cradle.reason: Keep deck projection within existing bank mouth with clearance; increase frequency mainly. Angle candidates14/16 exceed bank halfwidth. No port/model changes.

intenseAdjustment.codeStatus: No specific physical path defect established; no world timestep/player CCD/hidden force change. CODE updated fallback and new preview assets; tests written but not run.
